questions.question: How long has the anxiety been showing up?
questions.subtext: Honest answers help us match the right psychologist.

options.label: Just the last few weeks
A few months now
More than six months
Honestly, as long as I can remember

questions.question: Which of these feel most familiar?
questions.subtext: Pick everything that fits — there's no wrong answer.

options.label: My mind races at night and I can't switch off
I avoid situations even when I know I shouldn't
I feel it in my body — chest, jaw, shoulders
I worry about things going wrong before they happen
I get short with people I love when I'm stretched

questions.question: When does it hit hardest?
questions.subtext: Choose the moment that comes up most.

options.label: Right when I wake up
At work or before something I have to do
In social situations or around new people
At night, when everything goes quiet

questions.question: What part of life is it affecting most?
questions.subtext: We'll focus your programme around what matters most to you.

options.label: My work or studies
My relationships and family
My sleep and energy
How I feel about myself

questions.question: Have you tried anything for this before?
questions.subtext: Whatever you've done — or haven't — is fine.

options.label: No, this is my first step
Books, apps, breathing exercises
Therapy or counselling in the past
I'm seeing someone now but want more support

questions.question: How ready do you feel to actually work on this?
questions.subtext: It's okay if the answer is 'not very' — we'll meet you there.

questions.question: What would feel different if things were better?
questions.subtext: There's no right answer — pick what resonates.

options.label: I'd sleep through the night without my mind racing
I'd say yes to things I usually avoid
I'd feel calm in my own body again
I'd stop bracing for the next thing to go wrong
